newsitem.title: USA: Dollar/mark calms around 1.79 marks in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Dollar/mark calms around 1.79 marks in Europe.

text.p: 1230 GMT - Dollar calms around 1.79 marks in Europe after earlier testing new near six-year high of 1.7960. General mark weakness also sees 6-1/2 year high in stg/mark, 23-month low in mark/yen. Dlr/yen relatively stable around 114. Mark soft on crosses, off early lows vs lira but mark/franc slightly firmer. French president Chirac says French '97 deficit around 3.5 pct.
